exposure: Time interval between previous caesarean delivery and caesarean scar pregnancy
time interval between previous caesarean delivery and CSP
outcome: Success rate of single-dose methotrexate in treating caesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: Women treated for caesarean scar pregnancy between 2011 and 2019
finding: A single dose of methotrexate combined with ultrasound-guided needle aspiration for cases with active fetal heartbeat was found to be an effective treatment for caesarean scar pregnancy, with good subsequent pregnancy outcomes.
